title.zh: 基本再生数 R₀ · 传播曲线
title.en: The basic reproduction number R₀ · epidemic curves

description.zh: R₀ 是一个病例在没人免疫、没有干预时平均传给几个人：大于 1，病例一代比一代多；小于 1，传播逐渐熄灭。干预把有效再生数 Rₑ 压低，曲线跟着变平，但变平不等于消失。
description.en: R₀ is how many people one case infects on average when nobody is immune and nothing is done: above 1 cases multiply each generation, below 1 the outbreak dies out. Interventions push the effective number Rₑ down and flatten the curve — but flatter is not the same as gone.

reason.zh: 每个病例传给 R 个人，病例数就一代乘一次 R：R > 1 时指数增长，R < 1 时指数衰减；页面的曲线正是按有效 R 定出的指数增长率画的。
reason.en: Each case passes it to R others, so case numbers are multiplied by R every generation: exponential growth when R > 1, exponential decay when R < 1; the page’s curve is drawn with an exponential growth rate set by the effective R.
